subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.
Use the right-hand brush to sweep the remaining white block into the left-hand dustpan. Keep the green and yellow blocks inside.
Sweep the yellow block at the entrance well inside the dustpan with the right-hand brush. Keep white and green inside.

Lift the brush clear of the blocks and place it on the table to the right of the dustpan, more than 10 cm apart along x. Leave the loaded dustpan level on the table, fully open both grippers, and return both arms to their initial poses.
Return both empty arms to their episode-start poses with both grippers fully open. Leave the brush and loaded dustpan where they are.
